description: This file defines the IGraphicBufferConsumer interface in the Android graphics system, including methods for buffer management, connection handling, and configuration of buffer properties.

classes.name: IGraphicBufferConsumer
classes.description: Interface for consuming graphic buffers, including methods for acquiring, attaching, detaching, releasing buffers, and configuring buffer properties.

classes.name: BnGraphicBufferConsumer
classes.description: Binder interface class for IGraphicBufferConsumer, handling IPC transactions.

methods.name: acquireBuffer
methods.description: Attempts to acquire ownership of the next pending buffer in the BufferQueue, returning status and buffer info.

methods.name: detachBuffer
methods.description: Removes ownership of a buffer in a specified slot from the buffer queue.

methods.name: attachBuffer
methods.description: Transfers ownership of a buffer to the BufferQueue, assigning it to a slot.

methods.name: releaseBuffer
methods.description: Releases a buffer slot back to the BufferQueue, signaling when the buffer is no longer in use.

methods.name: consumerConnect
methods.description: Connects a consumer to the BufferQueue, establishing control and control mode.

methods.name: consumerDisconnect
methods.description: Disconnects the consumer from the BufferQueue, freeing buffers and abandoning the queue.

methods.name: getReleasedBuffers
methods.description: Retrieves a mask of buffers that have been released but not yet acknowledged by the consumer.

methods.name: setDefaultBufferSize
methods.description: Sets the default size for buffers returned by dequeueBuffer.

methods.name: setMaxBufferCount
methods.description: Sets the maximum number of buffers in the BufferQueue.

methods.name: setMaxAcquiredBufferCount
methods.description: Sets the maximum number of buffers that can be acquired by the consumer at once.

methods.name: setConsumerName
methods.description: Sets the name used in logging for the consumer.

methods.name: setDefaultBufferFormat
methods.description: Sets the default pixel format for buffers.

methods.name: setDefaultBufferDataSpace
methods.description: Requests buffers of a specific data space.

methods.name: setConsumerUsageBits
methods.description: Enables additional usage bits for buffers.

methods.name: setConsumerIsProtected
methods.description: Indicates whether the consumer can handle protected buffers.

methods.name: setTransformHint
methods.description: Bakes in rotation/transform hints into buffers for overlay use.

methods.name: getSidebandStream
methods.description: Retrieves the sideband buffer stream, if any.

methods.name: getOccupancyHistory
methods.description: Retrieves and clears occupancy history segments of the BufferQueue.

methods.name: discardFreeBuffers
methods.description: Releases all free buffers held by the BufferQueue to reduce memory usage.

methods.name: dumpState
methods.description: Dumps the internal state of the BufferQueue into a string for debugging.
